4:t_009:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...All units, withdraw. We're abandoning this area.」

4:t_009:6.en:
$$アル$$
「That is the appropriate decision. Sergeant, pull back.」

4:t_009:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You heard her, all units. We'll pull back and regroup.」

4:t_009:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Remember, this battle isn't over yet.」

4:t_011:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Is your 《$$血塗られた眼$$》 all right now!?」

4:t_011:4.en:
$n
「But right now, I have to do this!」

4:t_100:0.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$オズマ$$, if this keeps up...!」

4:t_100:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I know...! But if we pull back...!」

4:t_100:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
(I'm sorry, $$ランカ$$... I may never see you again...)

4:t_101:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$アルト$$...! Enemies are coming from every direction!」

4:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll shoot every last one down!」

4:t_101:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「You can't! There are too many!」

4:t_101:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I know that! But I have to do it!」

4:t_102:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Damn! I'm not happy that there are so many I don't even have to aim!」

4:t_102:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「Stop whining, $$ミシェル$$! If we don't do this, Earth will...!」

4:t_102:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I know! Today, I'm shooting everything in sight!」

4:t_103:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Stay back, $$さやか$$! It's dangerous here!」

4:t_103:1.en:
$$さやか$$
「What are you saying, $$甲児$$!? I'm a warrior who protects Earth, too!」

4:t_103:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「Let's go, $$甲児$$! We have to protect everything we care about!」

4:t_103:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah! Then we'll just have to fight with everything we've got!」

4:t_104:0.en:
$$ボス$$
「R-$$竜馬$$, this is crazy! Let's pull back!」

4:t_104:3.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Make up your minds, all of you!」

4:t_104:4.en:
$$隼人$$
「If we retreat, all that awaits us is hell.」

4:t_104:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go! We'll push forward and smash our way through this!」

4:t_105:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I mustn't run away... I mustn't run away...!」

4:t_105:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「We've fought so hard to protect Earth...! So... this time, too...!」

4:t_106:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't push it, $$宗介$$! Charge in recklessly and they'll gang up on you!」

4:t_106:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm counting on you to hold off the enemies around us! I'm moving forward!」

4:t_106:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch... Fine! Guess I have no choice!」

4:t_106:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant, this tactic can only be described as reckless.」

4:t_106:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't need you to tell me that.」

4:t_106:5.en:
$$アル$$
「If you understand that, I have nothing more to say. I will provide all possible support.」

4:t_106:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「...It seems you understand our situation, too.」

4:t_106:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's do this...! We'll shoot down as many enemies as we can!」

4:t_106:8.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$ is aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, too...! I'll protect her, no matter what...!)

4:t_107:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I came to watch the $$時の牢獄$$ collapse. I never expected this.」

4:t_107:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「Today was supposed to be a celebration. Who'd have thought it'd become Earth's worst day?」

4:t_107:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We're here to stop that from happening.」

4:t_107:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Roger that, $$ベン$$! Let's show them what we and Earth are really made of!」

4:t_108:0.en:
$$ファ$$
「We have to fight this many enemies in our condition...!」

4:t_108:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Focus, $$ファ$$! Let your guard down for even a second, and you're dead!」

4:t_108:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Their numbers are overwhelming...! If this keeps up, sooner or later...)

4:t_109:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Damn it...! Damn it! How could this happen...!?」

4:t_109:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! You have to focus on what's in front of you...!」

4:t_110:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「Haha... We're in so much trouble, all I can do is laugh.」

4:t_110:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「Even you can't seem to muster your usual optimism.」

4:t_110:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$マリ$$...! This isn't the time for that...!」

4:t_110:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「I know, Teach! At this point, we've just gotta throw caution to the wind!」

4:t_110:6.en:
$n
(《$$アドヴェント#keyword$$》... I'll... create hope...!)

4:t_111:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Lieutenant $$キャシー$$... Send me the tactical analysis data in real time.」

4:t_111:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(The odds are overwhelmingly against us... If I mistime our withdrawal, we could all be wiped out...)

4:t_112:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain...! The enemy vastly outmatches us! We can't win a battle of attrition!」

4:t_112:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, the others and I all know that!」

4:t_112:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「But even so, we cannot retreat! That's our duty as soldiers!」

4:t_112:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「That said, I have no intention of letting the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ sink!」

4:t_112:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「XO! Keep constant watch on our damage! Depending on the situation, we may have to withdraw!」
